description: This file defines a custom UI control named EquationTextBox for a calculator application, handling properties, events, and UI interactions related to mathematical equations and their visual representation.

classes.name: EquationTextBox
classes.description: A custom control for editing and displaying mathematical equations within the calculator app, supporting properties, events, and UI interactions.

methods.name: SetEquationText
methods.description: Sets the equation text in the embedded MathRichEditBox control.

methods.name: FocusTextBox
methods.description: Attempts to set focus to the MathRichEditBox control programmatically.

methods.name: OnApplyTemplate
methods.description: Initializes control template parts and attaches event handlers.

methods.name: OnPointerEntered
methods.description: Handles pointer entering the control area, updating visual state.

methods.name: OnPointerExited
methods.description: Handles pointer exiting the control area, updating visual state.

methods.name: OnPointerCanceled
methods.description: Handles pointer cancelation, updating visual state.

methods.name: OnPointerCaptureLost
methods.description: Handles loss of pointer capture, updating visual state.

methods.name: OnIsAddEquationModePropertyChanged
methods.description: Updates visual state when the IsAddEquationMode property changes.

methods.name: UpdateCommonVisualState
methods.description: Determines and applies the visual state based on current properties and pointer status.

methods.name: UpdateButtonsVisualState
methods.description: Updates the visibility and state of control buttons based on focus and content.

methods.name: RichEditHasContent
methods.description: Checks if the embedded MathRichEditBox contains any text.

methods.name: OnRichEditBoxGotFocus
methods.description: Handles focus gained event for the MathRichEditBox.

methods.name: OnRichEditBoxLostFocus
methods.description: Handles focus lost event for the MathRichEditBox.

methods.name: OnRichEditTextChanged
methods.description: Handles text change events in the MathRichEditBox.

methods.name: OnDeleteButtonClicked
methods.description: Clears the MathRichEditBox content and disables the function button.

methods.name: OnEquationButtonClicked
methods.description: Raises the EquationButtonClicked event and updates tooltip and automation name.

methods.name: OnRemoveButtonClicked
methods.description: Removes the equation text and updates control states.

methods.name: OnColorChooserButtonClicked
methods.description: Displays the color chooser flyout and logs the action.

methods.name: OnFunctionButtonClicked
methods.description: Raises the KeyGraphFeaturesButtonClicked event.

methods.name: OnFunctionMenuButtonClicked
methods.description: Submits the equation and raises the KeyGraphFeaturesButtonClicked event.

methods.name: OnRichEditMenuOpened
methods.description: Enables or disables context menu items based on current state.

methods.name: OnCutClicked
methods.description: Cuts selected text from the MathRichEditBox.

methods.name: OnCopyClicked
methods.description: Copies selected text from the MathRichEditBox.

methods.name: OnPasteClicked
methods.description: Pastes clipboard content into the MathRichEditBox.

methods.name: OnUndoClicked
methods.description: Undoes the last change in the MathRichEditBox.

methods.name: OnSelectAllClicked
methods.description: Selects all text in the MathRichEditBox.

methods.name: OnColorFlyoutOpened
methods.description: Updates state when the color flyout opens.

methods.name: OnColorFlyoutClosed
methods.description: Updates state when the color flyout closes.

methods.name: OnHasErrorPropertyChanged
methods.description: Updates visual state when the HasError property changes.

methods.name: OnEquationButtonContentIndexPropertyChanged
methods.description: Updates tooltip and automation name when the button content index changes.

methods.name: SetEquationButtonTooltipAndAutomationName
methods.description: Sets the tooltip and automation name for the equation toggle button based on current state.
